functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the solution meets the stated requirements and produces the correct output for the given inputs.

edge_case_handling.description: Assesses how well the solution handles edge cases or unusual inputs that could affect its performance or correctness.

efficiency.description: Measures the time and space complexity of the solution, ensuring it meets specified performance requirements.

robustness.description: Evaluates the solution's ability to handle unexpected inputs or situations without failing.

api_library_usage.description: Assesses the appropriateness and effectiveness of any APIs or libraries used in the solution.

readability.description: Evaluates how easy the code is to read, understand, and maintain, including naming conventions and code structure.

error_handling.description: Assesses how well the code anticipates and handles potential errors and security vulnerabilities.

bug_sensitivity.description: Assesses the solution's ability to handle edge cases and identify subtle bugs introduced during the editing process.

engineering_quality.description: Measures the overall quality of the code, including structure, adherence to best practices, and use of efficient algorithms.

maintainability.description: Evaluates how easy it is to modify or extend the solution in the future, considering structure and documentation.

error_security_handling.description: Measures how well the solution safeguards against potential security vulnerabilities and errors that could lead to failures.

clarity.description: Assesses how clear and comprehensible the code is, including comments and overall structure.

performance.description: Evaluates the code's performance, particularly its time and space complexity relative to the task requirements.

error_handling_security.description: Assesses how well the code anticipates and handles potential errors, user inputs, or security vulnerabilities.

boundary_conditions.description: Evaluates how well the code handles boundary conditions and limits.

compliance_with_standards.description: Assesses adherence to coding standards and guidelines.

testing_and_validation.description: Measures the extent to which the solution includes tests to validate functionality and robustness.

modularity.description: Evaluates the separation of functionality into distinct modules or functions, promoting reusability.

documentation.description: Assesses the completeness and clarity of comments and documentation associated with the code.
